component.name: MediaTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" end sub
sub runTask() ' No settle delay needed: the extension tick() that drains the construction-time replay ' queue runs before every subsequent statement (deterministic, not time-based), so by the ' time these fields are read a few statements later, both nodes have already settled. poster = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TaskPoster") anim = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TaskAnimatedImage") print "poster loadStatus:" + poster.findNode("p").loadStatus print "poster observed:" + poster.observed.toStr() print "anim state:" + anim.findNode("a").state print "anim observedCount:" + anim.observedCount.toStr() m.top.finished = true end sub
